notes.title: 🐸 Frog Galaxy Survivor is Back!
notes.notes: [p]🐸 Hello, friends![/p][p]You may remember that the original developer, Hunt Games, was forced to pause work on Frog Galaxy Survivor due to difficulties and the large amount of work ahead. This was truly sad news, as the game had already won the hearts of many players with its engaging gameplay and vibrant style. It would be a real shame to leave such a promising project unfinished.[/p][p]💥 That’s why we, the team at Whale Rock Games, decided to give Frog Galaxy Survivor another chance! We’re excited to continue development and bring the game all the way to a full release. Here’s what we have planned:[/p][p]🎮 Completely rework the gameplay foundation, turning it into a truly captivating vampire survivor-like[/p][p]🌌 Add new locations with unique enemies and mechanics[/p][p]🔫 Expand Frogus’s arsenal — expect even more powerful and stylish weapons[/p][p]🎯 Refresh the interface — modern, user-friendly, and pleasing to the eye[/p][p]🛠 Fix bugs and implement many other improvements[/p][p]We’d also love to hear your thoughts: what do you think about the current version of the game, and what do you feel it’s missing? Your feedback will help us shape the game into exactly what you want it to be.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. Frog Galaxy Survivor is coming back — and this is just the beginning of its journey![/p][p]🚀 With love,[/p][p]The Whale Rock Games Team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156380/75c2ca6a8d3f84dc443e8e269d8d30d1f1665a75.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Frog Galaxy Survivor - New Direction and Name Change
notes.notes:
This event marks a significant milestone in the development of my game. After listening to your feedback and evaluating the project's direction, I’ve decided to change the game’s name to "Frog Galaxy Survivor" in order to align better with the Roguelike genre and better describe the type of experience I want to offer.

Instead of escaping, the frog will now face waves of enemies in a galactic universe, with a focus on survival, collecting power cards, and procedurally generated levels. This change is part of the game’s natural evolution into a Roguelike with deeper and more dynamic gameplay mechanics.

Join the event to explore this new direction, ask questions, and share your thoughts on the rework! The game is still being developed to provide you with the best possible experience. 🚀

notes.title: Demo Update for Frog's Galaxy Escape!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to release the latest update for the Frog's Galaxy Escape demo! Here are the changes:

[list]
New Menu: The main menu has been revamped for a more intuitive and user-friendly experience. 
[/list]
[list]
Improved Colors: All in-game colors have been enhanced, making the visual experience more pleasant and immersive.
[/list]
[list]
First Level Adjustments: The last two stages of the first level have been removed as they were too lengthy for a tutorial, providing a smoother introduction to the game.
[/list]

We’re still hard at work improving the demo, and while there’s more to polish, this update marks an important step toward a better and more enjoyable gameplay experience. We look forward to your feedback!

notes.title: Free Game During Steam Neo Fest !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156380/45a094fcb4275b0bbabe136e1ab52558839158cd.png[/img]

Get ready for an intergalactic adventure with Frog's Galaxy Escape! We're excited to announce that our game will be part of the Steam Neo Fest from October 14th to 21st. During this event, you can play the game for free and experience the thrill of guiding Frogus through various universes to save his friends and the Earth, which has been transformed into puzzle pieces by a mysterious vortex. Don’t forget to add the game to your wishlist on Steam, and stay tuned for more updates. See you at the Steam Neo Fest!
